hypotheses.title: Batch 70: Orthogonal Cashflow & Topline Sales Breakout (Targeting 5th Bonus Approved Alpha)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Pivots completely away from saturated earnings multiples (operating income, EBIT, EBITDA) by deploying untouched fundamental cashflow and topline revenue metrics into our verified 3-term low-turnover multi-factor architecture: (1) Actual Cash Flow Per Share Yield in TOP2000 (Market Neutral): Captures pure operational cash generation per share without accounting accrual distortions. (2) Quarterly Topline Sales Yield in TOP2000 (Market Neutral): Exploits enterprise revenue yields that cannot be manipulated by depreciation or tax structuring. (3) Annual Topline Sales Yield in TOP1000 (Industry Neutral): Smoothed 252-day annual sales valuation in large-caps with intra-industry neutrality. (4) Short-Term Cash Cushion Yield in TOP1000 (Industry Neutral): Cash-to-price balance-sheet liquidity buffer protecting against market stress.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if topline revenue or balance-sheet cash reserves fail to generate positive cross-sectional risk premia over equity price.
